fixture.name: generic-farm-full
assumptions: Standard generic profile from Byzantine raw units; only explicit economic techs are replayed. Treadmill Crane is excluded.
Integer carry rounded after each upgrade: base 10, Wheelbarrow 13, Heavy Plow 14, Hand Cart 21. Engine rounding is historical evidence, not a current executable trace.
Farm replenishment and buffer are separate from worker harvesting. Initial available pool is zero; listed farm food includes all food in this model.
Centered 2x2 work area reflects DE update 50292. Nine grid points and uniform choice excluding the previous point are a community-informed approximation.
Four equal portions per load approximate observed quarter-load moves. Variable portion sizes and occasional fifth stops are unresolved, tested separately.
No fixed stand timer: harvest rate and pool availability determine time at each spot. Instant deposits at body contact; no invented deposit animation delay.
Rigid circular collisions and shortest visibility routes approximate engine pathing. Farms are passable; mill is solid. Dynamic priority rotates every second.
Starts: finished farms, empty food pools, empty-handed workers at farm centers; walk to first chosen working spot. Initial construction excluded.
Reseed diagnostic deposits any final partial load, returns to the previous working spot, rebuilds for 15 seconds, and pays 60 wood from an external wood budget.
Not current-DE trajectory validation; do not use as a calibrated civilization-bonus predictor yet.

fixture.name: generic-wood-w3-c2
assumptions: Generic Byzantine lumberjack values; only selected standard economic upgrades applied. Sappers is absent.
Live tree: source 20 HP and 100 wood. Felling HP and remaining wood are separate. Felled tree keeps its resource footprint until depleted.
No armor entries on tree; summed worker attack classes give 15 damage per swing, two swings to fell.
First swing assumed at half of the current DAT 2-second animation; subsequent swings use coded reload 2 seconds. Raw frame_delay=0 does not resolve worker-task impact timing.
Historical measured 2.25-second total felling is a separate sensitivity case, not silently imposed on the current DAT.
Rigid circular workers and conservative rectangular resource obstacles reuse the gold experiment geometry/pathfinder.
Instant deposits at contact. Partial loads continue to the next tree; all resources exhausted causes final partial deposit.
Workers return to their tree while it is available, choose another accessible tree on depletion or blocked destination, and retry blocked paths after 0.5 game-seconds.
No camp rebuilding. Depletion exposes inner trees and removes empty-tree obstacles; stumps do not obstruct.
One fixed camp, eight-tile-wide six-deep forest, workers initially spread on the front edge at 0.6-tile center spacing.
Observed rates are scenario/model estimates; the same-layout current DE trajectories have not been captured.

fixture.name: generic-post-imperial-gold

reference.name: Forgotten Empires: Gold & Relics
reference.conditions: One tile from camp, both mining upgrades + Hand Cart, no bumping; patch unspecified

assumptions: Generic mining inputs from Byzantine records; no civilization/team bonuses used.
Carry rounded to nearest integer after each technology, consistent with historical community tests; current DE not captured.
Workers are rigid circles of source radius; minimum collision multiplier is preserved but not activated.
Gold and camp are rectangles; navigation uses conservative expanded-rectangle corners.
Continuous source work rate; instantaneous deposit and task switch at contact.
Workers return to their assigned gold object, selecting reachable contact points; retarget on depletion.
Visibility routing around current worker positions; blocked paths retry after 0.5 game-seconds.
Movement updates are sequential, priority rotates once per game-second; no physical pushing.
No parameter is fitted to the external reference; this is an unvalidated economic model.

fixture.name: generic-farm-full
assumptions: Standard generic profile from Byzantine raw units; only explicit economic techs are replayed. Treadmill Crane is excluded.
Integer carry rounded after each upgrade: base 10, Wheelbarrow 13, Heavy Plow 14, Hand Cart 21. Engine rounding is historical evidence, not a current executable trace.
Farm replenishment and buffer are separate from worker harvesting. Initial available pool is zero; listed farm food includes all food in this model.
Centered 2x2 work area reflects DE update 50292. Nine grid points and uniform choice excluding the previous point are a community-informed approximation.
Four equal portions per load approximate observed quarter-load moves. Variable portion sizes and occasional fifth stops are unresolved, tested separately.
No fixed stand timer: harvest rate and pool availability determine time at each spot. Instant deposits at body contact; no invented deposit animation delay.
Rigid circular collisions and shortest visibility routes approximate engine pathing. Farms are passable; mill is solid. Dynamic priority rotates every second.
Starts: finished farms, empty food pools, empty-handed workers at farm centers; walk to first chosen working spot. Initial construction excluded.
Reseed diagnostic deposits any final partial load, returns to the previous working spot, rebuilds for 15 seconds, and pays 60 wood from an external wood budget.
Not current-DE trajectory validation; do not use as a calibrated civilization-bonus predictor yet.

fixture.name: generic-wood-w3-c2
assumptions: Generic Byzantine lumberjack values; only selected standard economic upgrades applied. Sappers is absent.
Live tree: source 20 HP and 100 wood. Felling HP and remaining wood are separate. Felled tree keeps its resource footprint until depleted.
No armor entries on tree; summed worker attack classes give 15 damage per swing, two swings to fell.
First swing assumed at half of the current DAT 2-second animation; subsequent swings use coded reload 2 seconds. Raw frame_delay=0 does not resolve worker-task impact timing.
Historical measured 2.25-second total felling is a separate sensitivity case, not silently imposed on the current DAT.
Rigid circular workers and conservative rectangular resource obstacles reuse the gold experiment geometry/pathfinder.
Instant deposits at contact. Partial loads continue to the next tree; all resources exhausted causes final partial deposit.
Workers return to their tree while it is available, choose another accessible tree on depletion or blocked destination, and retry blocked paths after 0.5 game-seconds.
No camp rebuilding. Depletion exposes inner trees and removes empty-tree obstacles; stumps do not obstruct.
One fixed camp, eight-tile-wide six-deep forest, workers initially spread on the front edge at 0.6-tile center spacing.
Observed rates are scenario/model estimates; the same-layout current DE trajectories have not been captured.

fixture.name: generic-farm-full
assumptions: Standard generic profile from Byzantine raw units; only explicit economic techs are replayed. Treadmill Crane is excluded.
Integer carry rounded after each upgrade: base 10, Wheelbarrow 13, Heavy Plow 14, Hand Cart 21. Engine rounding is historical evidence, not a current executable trace.
Farm replenishment and buffer are separate from worker harvesting. Initial available pool is zero; listed farm food includes all food in this model.
Centered 2x2 work area reflects DE update 50292. Nine grid points and uniform choice excluding the previous point are a community-informed approximation.
Four equal portions per load approximate observed quarter-load moves. Variable portion sizes and occasional fifth stops are unresolved, tested separately.
No fixed stand timer: harvest rate and pool availability determine time at each spot. Instant deposits at body contact; no invented deposit animation delay.
Rigid circular collisions and shortest visibility routes approximate engine pathing. Farms are passable; mill is solid. Dynamic priority rotates every second.
Starts: finished farms, empty food pools, empty-handed workers at farm centers; walk to first chosen working spot. Initial construction excluded.
Reseed diagnostic deposits any final partial load, returns to the previous working spot, rebuilds for 15 seconds, and pays 60 wood from an external wood budget.
Not current-DE trajectory validation; do not use as a calibrated civilization-bonus predictor yet.

fixture.name: generic-wood-w3-c2
assumptions: Generic Byzantine lumberjack values; only selected standard economic upgrades applied. Sappers is absent.
Live tree: source 20 HP and 100 wood. Felling HP and remaining wood are separate. Felled tree keeps its resource footprint until depleted.
No armor entries on tree; summed worker attack classes give 15 damage per swing, two swings to fell.
First swing assumed at half of the current DAT 2-second animation; subsequent swings use coded reload 2 seconds. Raw frame_delay=0 does not resolve worker-task impact timing.
Historical measured 2.25-second total felling is a separate sensitivity case, not silently imposed on the current DAT.
Rigid circular workers and conservative rectangular resource obstacles reuse the gold experiment geometry/pathfinder.
Instant deposits at contact. Partial loads continue to the next tree; all resources exhausted causes final partial deposit.
Workers return to their tree while it is available, choose another accessible tree on depletion or blocked destination, and retry blocked paths after 0.5 game-seconds.
No camp rebuilding. Depletion exposes inner trees and removes empty-tree obstacles; stumps do not obstruct.
One fixed camp, eight-tile-wide six-deep forest, workers initially spread on the front edge at 0.6-tile center spacing.
Observed rates are scenario/model estimates; the same-layout current DE trajectories have not been captured.

fixture.name: generic-farm-full
assumptions: Standard generic profile from Byzantine raw units; only explicit economic techs are replayed. Treadmill Crane is excluded.
Integer carry rounded after each upgrade: base 10, Wheelbarrow 13, Heavy Plow 14, Hand Cart 21. Engine rounding is historical evidence, not a current executable trace.
Farm replenishment and buffer are separate from worker harvesting. Initial available pool is zero; listed farm food includes all food in this model.
Centered 2x2 work area reflects DE update 50292. Nine grid points and uniform choice excluding the previous point are a community-informed approximation.
Four equal portions per load approximate observed quarter-load moves. Variable portion sizes and occasional fifth stops are unresolved, tested separately.
No fixed stand timer: harvest rate and pool availability determine time at each spot. Instant deposits at body contact; no invented deposit animation delay.
Rigid circular collisions and shortest visibility routes approximate engine pathing. Farms are passable; mill is solid. Dynamic priority rotates every second.
Starts: finished farms, empty food pools, empty-handed workers at farm centers; walk to first chosen working spot. Initial construction excluded.
Reseed diagnostic deposits any final partial load, returns to the previous working spot, rebuilds for 15 seconds, and pays 60 wood from an external wood budget.
Not current-DE trajectory validation; do not use as a calibrated civilization-bonus predictor yet.

fixture.name: generic-wood-w3-c2
assumptions: Generic Byzantine lumberjack values; only selected standard economic upgrades applied. Sappers is absent.
Live tree: source 20 HP and 100 wood. Felling HP and remaining wood are separate. Felled tree keeps its resource footprint until depleted.
No armor entries on tree; summed worker attack classes give 15 damage per swing, two swings to fell.
First swing assumed at half of the current DAT 2-second animation; subsequent swings use coded reload 2 seconds. Raw frame_delay=0 does not resolve worker-task impact timing.
Historical measured 2.25-second total felling is a separate sensitivity case, not silently imposed on the current DAT.
Rigid circular workers and conservative rectangular resource obstacles reuse the gold experiment geometry/pathfinder.
Instant deposits at contact. Partial loads continue to the next tree; all resources exhausted causes final partial deposit.
Workers return to their tree while it is available, choose another accessible tree on depletion or blocked destination, and retry blocked paths after 0.5 game-seconds.
No camp rebuilding. Depletion exposes inner trees and removes empty-tree obstacles; stumps do not obstruct.
One fixed camp, eight-tile-wide six-deep forest, workers initially spread on the front edge at 0.6-tile center spacing.
Observed rates are scenario/model estimates; the same-layout current DE trajectories have not been captured.

assumptions: Standard generic profile from Byzantine raw units; only explicit economic techs are replayed. Treadmill Crane is excluded.
Integer carry rounded after each upgrade: base 10, Wheelbarrow 13, Heavy Plow 14, Hand Cart 21. Engine rounding is historical evidence, not a current executable trace.
Farm replenishment and buffer are separate from worker harvesting. Initial available pool is zero; listed farm food includes all food in this model.
Centered 2x2 work area reflects DE update 50292. Nine grid points and uniform choice excluding the previous point are a community-informed approximation.
Four equal portions per load approximate observed quarter-load moves. Variable portion sizes and occasional fifth stops are unresolved, tested separately.
No fixed stand timer: harvest rate and pool availability determine time at each spot. Instant deposits at body contact; no invented deposit animation delay.
Rigid circular collisions and shortest visibility routes approximate engine pathing. Farms are passable; mill is solid. Dynamic priority rotates every second.
Starts: finished farms, empty food pools, empty-handed workers at farm centers; walk to first chosen working spot. Initial construction excluded.
Reseed diagnostic deposits any final partial load, returns to the previous working spot, rebuilds for 15 seconds, and pays 60 wood from an external wood budget.
Not current-DE trajectory validation; do not use as a calibrated civilization-bonus predictor yet.

Rigid circular workers and conservative rectangular resource obstacles reuse the gold experiment geometry/pathfinder.

No camp rebuilding. Depletion exposes inner trees and removes empty-tree obstacles; stumps do not obstruct.
One fixed camp, eight-tile-wide six-deep forest, workers initially spread on the front edge at 0.6-tile center spacing.
Observed rates are scenario/model estimates; the same-layout current DE trajectories have not been captured.
